faqs.question: Where is Exhibit On Superior located?
faqs.answer: Exhibit On Superior is located at 165 W Superior St, Chicago, IL 60654 in the River North area.

faqs.question: What is the phone number for Exhibit On Superior?
faqs.answer: The phone number is 312-450-0635.

faqs.question: What is the email for Exhibit On Superior?
faqs.answer: The contact email is exhibit@highlandptrs.com.

faqs.question: Who manages Exhibit On Superior?
faqs.answer: The community is professionally managed on site; contact the leasing office at exhibit@highlandptrs.com or 312-450-0635.

faqs.question: What apartment sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The community offers studio, convertible, one, two, and three-bedroom apartment homes from about 448 to 1,528 square feet across floors 2–34.

faqs.question: Do apartments have in-unit laundry?
faqs.answer: Yes. In-home washer/dryers are a standard apartment feature.

faqs.question: What finishes do apartments have?
faqs.answer: Homes feature driftwood plank floors, quartz countertops, tiled backsplashes, stainless-steel appliances, floor-to-ceiling windows, and private balconies in nearly every home.

faqs.question: What is the largest apartment?
faqs.answer: A three-bedroom, three-bath residence of 1,528 square feet on the penthouse-level floors 30–34.

faqs.question: Are furnished apartments available?
faqs.answer: No. Apartments are offered unfurnished only.

faqs.question: How do I check current pricing and availability?
faqs.answer: The Available Units page lists every available residence with live rent, photos, and move-in dates synced from the leasing system.

faqs.question: What fees are required in addition to rent?
faqs.answer: Each unit’s listing shows its application fee. There is also a $500 non-refundable administration fee per apartment and a monthly Utility & Service Amenity fee of $95–$195 by floor plan. There is no security deposit.

faqs.question: Are utilities included?
faqs.answer: The monthly Utility & Service Amenity fee covers water, sewer, trash, heat, A/C, and natural gas for cooking and the dryer; electricity is billed directly by ComEd.

faqs.question: Does Exhibit offer move-in specials?
faqs.answer: Exhibit is not offering move-in concessions at this time — ask the leasing team about future offers.

faqs.question: How much is parking?
faqs.answer: Garage parking in the attached indoor garage is $335 per month per unreserved space, subject to availability.

faqs.question: What amenities does Exhibit On Superior offer?
faqs.answer: Amenities include a full-floor amenity deck, fitness center, 75-foot lap pool, outdoor hot tub, sauna, lounges, work and meeting rooms, music studio, dog spa, grilling stations, fire pits, and outdoor areas.

faqs.question: Does Exhibit On Superior have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes — a 75-foot lap pool on the amenity floor, plus an outdoor hot tub and sauna.

faqs.question: Is there space to work from home?
faqs.answer: Yes. Private work and meeting rooms, a tech lounge with charging stations and kitchen, a library nook, and reading alcoves.

faqs.question: Does Exhibit have on-site retail?
faqs.answer: Yes. On-site retail and wellness options include fitness, food, and spa services.

faqs.question: Is there a 24-hour concierge?
faqs.answer: Yes. The front desk is staffed 24 hours a day, and indoor amenities are open 24/7.

faqs.question: Is Exhibit On Superior pet-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cats and dogs are welcome, with a maximum of 2 pets per apartment.

faqs.question: Are there pet amenities?
faqs.answer: Yes — a doggie spa and lounge inside the building and a gated outdoor dog walk.

faqs.question: What are the pet fees and breed rules?
faqs.answer: One-time non-refundable pet fee: $650 for one dog or $750 for two, $325 for cats. No pet deposit, no monthly pet rent, no weight limits. Breed restrictions apply — see a leasing consultant for details.

faqs.question: What neighborhood is Exhibit On Superior in?
faqs.answer: Exhibit On Superior is in River North in Chicago.

faqs.question: How close is the CTA?
faqs.answer: The Chicago Brown/Purple Line station (Chicago & Franklin) is about two blocks away; the Chicago Red Line station (Chicago & State) is roughly 0.3 miles.

faqs.question: Is Exhibit close to a grocery store?
faqs.answer: Yes. Whole Foods (3 W Chicago Ave), Jewel-Osco (550 N State St), and Trader Joe’s (44 E Ontario St) are all within about half a mile.

faqs.question: Is Exhibit walkable to the Loop?
faqs.answer: Yes — the Loop is roughly a mile south, about a 20-minute walk or one Brown Line stop.

faqs.question: What is nearby?
faqs.answer: Cafes, restaurants, shops, parks, the Chicago River, West Loop, Old Town, and Fulton Market.

faqs.question: How do I schedule a tour?
faqs.answer: Choose the residence you’re interested in on the Available Units page and use its Schedule a Tour button, email exhibit@highlandptrs.com, or call 312-450-0635.

faqs.question: Can I tour virtually?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Virtual Tour page includes video and Matterport tour embeds for apartment and amenity previews.

faqs.question: How do I apply?
faqs.answer: Open any available residence on the Available Units page and use its Apply Now button — each unit links directly to its own secure online application.

faqs.question: What credit score is required and are guarantors accepted?
faqs.answer: A minimum credit score of 700 is required, or 600+ with a qualified co-signer. Qualified co-signers are accepted.

faqs.question: What lease terms are available?
faqs.answer: 12+ month lease terms are available; short-term leases are offered based on availability. Approval typically takes 1–3 business days.

faqs.question: Who should residents contact?
faqs.answer: Residents can contact Exhibit On Superior at exhibit@highlandptrs.com or 312-450-0635.

faqs.question: Where should residents log in?
faqs.answer: Current residents use the resident portal linked from the Residents page for payments and maintenance requests.
